requirements.requirement: The system must validate via unit tests that the board certification UI schema includes fields for certification_status, issuing_body, and score_contribution.
The system must fail tests if any required schema field (certification_status, issuing_body, score_contribution) is missing or undefined.
The system must validate via unit tests that certification_status is correctly interpreted as certified or not certified based on input data.
The system must validate via unit tests that issuing_body values are normalized into a consistent display format.
The system must validate via unit tests that score_contribution is formatted correctly for display (e.g., percentage or numeric format).
The system must validate via integration tests that the MessageBubble component renders a certification status badge when certification data is present.
The system must validate via integration tests that the issuing body text is visible in the UI when provided.
The system must validate via integration tests that the score contribution is displayed within the provider scorecard section.
The system must validate end-to-end that data from backend measure EVAL-P-MEASURE-BOARD is correctly passed through logic and rendered without transformation errors.
The system must validate that when certification_status is null or missing, the UI renders a fallback state indicating unknown or unavailable certification.
The system must validate that when issuing_body is missing or empty, the UI does not render a blank label and instead omits or replaces it with a fallback value.
The system must validate that rendering does not crash or throw errors when all certification fields are absent from the input payload.
